text: 中国人民银行新闻发言人、副行长邹澜15日在国新办新闻发布会上表示，向前看，影响人民币汇率的因素较为多元，推动升值和贬值的因素都有，人民币汇率预计会继续双向波动。（新华财经）
text_en: PBOC spokesperson and Deputy Governor Zou Lan said at a State Council Information Office press conference on the 15th that looking ahead, factors influencing the renminbi exchange rate are diverse, with both appreciation and depreciation pressures, and the renminbi exchange rate is expected to continue two-way fluctuations. (Xinhua Finance)
